bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears (1-0) are set to host the Minnesota Vikings at Soldier Field for their home opener, riding high after a impressive 59-37 season-opening road win over the Panthers . Ahead of the Week 2 clash, the team released a clean injury report with everyone being available to play, including Darnell Wright , while the Vikings face uncertainty over whether Kyler Murray or Carson Wentz will start at quarterback.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are dealing with fallout from their 41-31 Week 2 loss to the Buffalo Bills, a game in which they scored 31 points and never had a chance against the Bills , exposing serious defensive issues. The setback has prompted the Lions to be expected to make changes, with star edge rusher Aidan Hutchinson saying the team has to do something and head coach Dan Campbell agreeing that things need to change.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers head into their Week 2 matchup against the New York Jets in New Jersey with a shorthanded defense, as DT Javon Hargrave has been downgraded to OUT while EDGE Lukas Van Ness was removed from the injury report . Meanwhile, the Packers' cornerback room got a boost ahead of their Week 2 matchup as rookie Brandon Cisse is set to be available after exiting Week 1 with cramps.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings are dealing with injury concerns heading into their Week 2 matchup against the Chicago Bears, as the team faces key questions with Kyler Murray out and Jordan Mason injured . Meanwhile, the Vikings made a roster move to help their cap situation, revising cornerback Isaiah Rodgers' contract to convert playtime incentives worth up to $1.5 million into a signing bonus, creating additional cap room .
